newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA'S PECHORSKAYA UTILITY REJECTS MERGER.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S PECHORSKAYA UTILITY REJECTS MERGER.

text.p: Russia's Pechora Hydro power company (AO Pechorskaya GRES) rejected a merger with AO Komienergo power utility, but the decision is not final, Pechora's chairman said on Wednesday.
"A positive decision was not taken as only about 70 percent of shareholders voted for it, not (the necessary) 75 percent," Alexei Lipatov told Reuters.
He said investors were not satisfied with the one-to-one ratio for converting Pechora Hydro shares into Komienergo ones.
Shareholders had already rejected a merger last year, when President Boris Yeltsin issued a decree on reorganising the Pechora Hydro by merging it with Komienergo.
But Unified Energy System (UES), the national power utility, which has a controlling stake in Pechora Hydro, called for a new vote.
Lipatov said it was up to the government of the Komi Republic and UES to decide what happens next.
